verses.1: And he commanded by the command: Let the abyss rejoice for the ungodly; from the holy place let the abyss deepen in the waters; and from the depths, the heat of the abyss by the command of the kingdom which you have given, which is the command of Meron, which is good, the perfection of all. And the faithful shall rise on their feet to hear the holy scriptures of the kingdom.
